styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small vertical sign with a dark red-brown frame, a lighter red body and a cream face carrying the 국밥 lettering. Its dark edge pixels are 0% near-neutral, so the outline leans red-brown and reads as a material tone, not a black sticker line. It has 8 visible tones per tile, above bus-shelter-a (6) and below kiosk-a (12) and vending-a (20). Near-flat coverage is 0%, so there are no large flat fills, and the lettering and panel edges add variation. The ramps are a little shallow at about 4 steps, against 5 or more on the references, but this is a thin, simple sign. Set next to the shipped modern_city props it would not look flatter or more sticker-like than bus-shelter-a, so it is acceptable.
